objective: Implement a provider-neutral video research fabric for timestamped transcript acquisition and video metadata/search.

rulesConsidered: Video research remains candidate evidence acquisition.
YouTube Data API is metadata/search-only for arbitrary public videos.
MCP is an access surface and never an authority.
No provider grants F06, CAS or F07 authority.

notes: All provider keys are loaded from server-side environment variables.
No arbitrary provider URL is accepted by the new provider adapters.

changes: Added typed video transcript and search contracts.
Implemented YouTube Data API metadata/search adapter.
Added deterministic fallback router and provider tests.
Promoted VidWords from UNVERIFIED to IMPLEMENTED based on current public API documentation.
verificationPlan: Require CI and Team Change Gate before merge.
Run live provider proofs only with explicitly configured credentials.
Keep YouTube publishing permissions and transcript research permissions separate.
notes: No live provider qualification is claimed by this PR.
YouTube Data API metadata/search is intentionally separated from arbitrary-video transcript extraction.
Transcript providers return normalized timestamped speech for downstream F00 research processing.
